text: Before there were any Forest Keepers, there was a forest. And at its edge stood an old oak tree, and one little acorn, asleep under the leaves.
Some acorns wait under the leaves all winter. And this one waited, until spring came and warmed the ground.
The leaves are all soft and wet. And the air smells like rain.
I'm awake. I'm green. And I have leaves on my head. But what am I? And where do I belong?
